addedParagraph: For a GitHub Actions release, start with the [GoReleaser workflow](#using-goreleaser-in-github-actions): it runs on a pushed tag and gives the job `contents: write`. The example passes `GITHUB_TOKEN` to the upstream `goreleaser/goreleaser-action`. To check the build and packaging locally before publishing, follow the [snapshot steps](#quick-start); this does not publish a release.

准备接入 GitHub Actions，可以直接看 [GoReleaser 工作流](#在-github-actions-中使用-goreleaser)：示例由推送 tag 触发，为 job 设置 `contents: write`，再把 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 传给上游的 `goreleaser/goreleaser-action`。先在本机检查构建和打包结果，可以从[本地 snapshot 步骤](#快速开始)开始，这一步不会发布 release。
